Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning credit and debit card transactions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to credit and debit card transactions; and addinga new section to chapter 19.200 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.200 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Credit card" means a card or device existing for the purposeof obtaining money, goods, or services on credit. (b) "Customer" means any person who is or may be required to payfor goods or services. (c) "Debit card" means a card or device used to obtain money,goods, or services by a transaction that debits a cardholder's account,rather than extending credit. (d) "Seller" means any person who provides, offers to provide, orarranges for others to provide goods or services to a customer inexchange for consideration. (2) When a customer is making a payment on an existing account, aseller may not require as a condition of payment by credit or debit p. 1 SHB 1534card that the customer consent to authorizing any future chargesagainst the customer's credit or debit card. (3) This section does not prohibit a seller from charging futurepayments against the customer's credit or debit card if the customerconsents. (4) This section does not prohibit a seller from requiring that acustomer provide credit or debit card information to the seller forfuture charges at the initiation of an account.
